cornerstone.holders: Wildlife Willow Limited; UBS AM Singapore (UBS Asset Management (Singapore) Ltd.); FOL (Formosa Opportunity Limited); Huaqin Telecom Hong Kong Limited; Sky Royal (SKY ROYAL TRADING LIMITED); PST (Pudong Science and Technology (Cayman) Co., Ltd.); JSC International Investment Fund SPC; Ghisallo (Ghisallo Fund Master Ltd); Dajia Life (Dajia Life Insurance Co., Ltd.); PSBC Wealth (PSBC Wealth Management Co., Ltd.)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, and will cause its affiliates not to, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; restricted period includes the Listing Date, frees up on the six-month anniversary

controller_6m.full_quote: (i) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his or its shareholding is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-month Period”), dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07 undertaking: First Six-month Period runs from the prospectus disclosure date and ends ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date; inclusive endpoint, so first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date

controller_12m.full_quote: (ii) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-month Period expires (the “Second Six-month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of the Relevant Securities if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests orencumbrances, any of them would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder or a member of the group of Controlling Shareholders, or together with the other Controlling Shareholders would cease to be a group of Controlling Shareholders.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b)-style undertaking: Second Six-month Period is six months commencing on the expiry of the First Six-month Period (the date which is six months from the Listing Date); duration wording frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
controller_12m.notes: Second period is conditional on ceasing to be a Controlling Shareholder; effective control maintenance = 12 months from Listing Date.
